prompt:
Analyze the following external review that has been addressed.
Identify what our INTERNAL code review should have caught
BEFORE the external reviewer found it.

## External Review Feedback
Hey - I've left some high level feedback:

- The new `tests/ci/verify_chaos_ci_pipeline.sh` script is very tightly coupled to the exact formatting and ordering in `ci.yaml` (e.g., full `needs:` line match, sed-based section extraction), which will make harmless workflow refactors noisy; consider making the assertions more resilient (e.g., matching individual `needs` entries or using smaller, more focused regexes) to reduce brittleness.
- Several checks in `verify_chaos_ci_pipeline.sh` manually repeat the pattern of extracting the `e2e-chaos` job section and then asserting on it; factoring that extraction and common assertions into small helper functions would simplify the script and make future changes to the job structure easier to accommodate.

(no code comments)

## Resolution Summary
Both review comments were addressed in tests/ci/verify_chaos_ci_pipeline.sh. The brittle full-line needs assertion was replaced with an assert_needs_entry() helper that matches individual dependency entries, tolerating reordering and formatting changes. Repeated inline sed-based e2e-chaos job section extraction (previously duplicated in test_e2e_chaos_timeout, test_e2e_chaos_continue_on_error, test_e2e_chaos_kind_cluster, test_e2e_chaos_builds_keystone, and test_e2e_chaos_junit_report) was centralized into an extract_yaml_job_section() helper with a single cached E2E_CHAOS_JOB_SECTION variable reused across all tests. The extract_yaml_job_section helper was also applied to test_e2e_chaos_publish_no_dependency (which extracts sections for publish jobs like build-and-push, helm-push, merge-operator-images, github-release) since it shares the same YAML section extraction pattern.

Extract 0-3 review improvement patterns. For each:
- name: Short, action-oriented name IN ENGLISH
- review_area: error-handling | security | testing | performance | type-safety | validation | architecture | naming | documentation
- detection_hint: How should the reviewer detect this?
- severity: BLOCKING | WARNING
- what_to_check: What exactly to check
- why_it_matters: Why it matters
- example_feedback: Original quote from the reviewer
- example_fix: What was changed

QUALITY: Only real review blindspots. No subjective style opinions.
Nothing that only a domain expert could know.
If nothing extractable: empty array.

LANGUAGE: ALL fields MUST be in English.

Response: ONLY JSON array.
